findings.claim: Strudel adopted a 'Post-AI humane policy': contributions including LLM-generated content are declined and LLM-generated forum posts/comments get flagged and deleted.
findings.excerpt: Contributions including LLM-generated content will be declined.

findings.claim: The policy also strongly discourages importing Strudel projects into corporate AI platforms, naming GitHub; canonical repo is codeberg.org/uzu/strudel.
findings.excerpt: announcement by yaxu linking POLICY.md on Codeberg

last_10_commits.message: Add source links for my featured tracks

notes: Forum: Strudel category has 74 topics total across 3 JSON pages; 15 active since 2026-05-01 (all listed; questions kept where they teach a technique). Pattern code was not copied; forum items are indexed by title/link only. Mastodon: 6 tag timelines (mastodon.social + post.lurk.org × strudel/livecoding/algorave) paginated back to ~June–July 2026; 413 unique posts since 2026-08-01, 153 mention Strudel after dropping pastry posts; 40 curated. Prolific series (pikesley ≈20 sketches, bryce_avx Looptober 31 videos, unknown_deleter ≈30 from-scratch videos) are each recorded as one or a few representative items. Window covered is Aug–Oct 2026 (3 months). strudel.cc share links embed the code in the URL fragment, so they are recorded as 'strudel.cc share link' and the post URL is used instead, to avoid copying code. Bluesky: public.api.bsky.app returned HTTP 403 (Cloudflare page) and q=%23strudel returned 400 InvalidRequest; api.bsky.app worked without auth using q=strudel.cc and q=strudel&tag=strudel (96 posts since Aug 1, many bridged Mastodon posts or pastry); 15 curated. bsky.app post URLs are built from the at:// URI handle + rkey returned by the API. awesome-strudel: gh api plus Atom feed (20 entries, HTTP 200). Policy flag: Strudel's new no-LLM POLICY.md (2026-10-28) is directly relevant to soda.strudel, an AI-assisted project; it covers contributions and forum posting, not personal use, so posting AI-assisted material to uzu.lurk.org or upstream would conflict with it. Working files: raw API dumps under scratchpad/harvest/raw/ plus masto.py and build.py helper scripts.
